title: BMS Index 2024 — Nestlé country scorecard
methodology: Benchmarking of marketing practices for breast-milk substitutes against specific provisions of the WHO International Code in five selected markets: China, Germany, Indonesia, United States and Viet Nam. Assessed channels include product labels, online media and traditional media.
limitations: ATNi states that it assesses alignment with the WHO Code and guidance, not compliance with local laws. Results are limited to the five selected markets, available data and sampled products/channels; incidence counts are observations, not court findings or necessarily unique incidents.
